mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above the prior six-month average signals stronger household demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 3-month YoY growth exceeds prior 6-month average by >0.5pp
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive in at least 70% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market that raises wage pressure and inflation expectations, which erodes equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative in at least 60% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A two-month contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below the prior six-month average signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO 3-month YoY growth below prior 6-month average
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative in at least 60% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year window.

failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative in at least 60% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year window.
